Title: Azure Container Registry is now available in West US 3

Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry is now generally available in West US 3 region. Azure Container Registry allows you to build, store, and manage images and artifacts for all types of container deployments.

To learn more, read the Container Registry product page and documentation.

See the list of all regions where Azure Container Registry is available and where it's coming next.
